name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ai, descriptor=walk_to_target_tile). No address residue. Accurately reflects purpose: an AI/player character walks along a path toward a target tile, with unreachable-target fallback.
purpose: Walk an AI (or player) character along a computed path toward a target tile, falling back to the closest approachable adjacent tile when the target itself is unreachable, then animate the move.
logic_summary: Reads src pos, remaining move range (runtime_char+0x3B), and movement class (runtime_char+0x20) for char_idx; overrides class to 0x13 when fd2_check_char_status_immunity!=0 and to 1 when runtime_char+8 (job id) == 0x1C. Gets the per-job move-cost table, allocates a 0x20 path buffer and a 0x800 tile-position buffer. Stage A: fd2_pathfind_to_destination within range_rem toward (target_x,target_y). If 0xFF (unreachable), Stage B: retry with range 0x1C and long-range mode; if that succeeds, init floodfill from src, walk the path step bytes (0=S,1=W,2=N,3=E) and track the furthest tile whose tile-map byte[7]!=0xFF (walkable), then adopt it as the new target. Best-adjacent-tile pick: obfuscate map + paint_threat_overlay + init_movement_range_floodfill + mark_char_occupant_tiles + collect_unmarked_tile_positions, then scan candidates for the smallest taxicab distance to (target_x,target_y), tiebreaking on smaller |dx|-|dy| (straighter approach). Final pathfind to the chosen tile; if a path of non-zero length exists, fd2_walk_path_animation_loop animates it and the return value becomes 1, else 0. Frees both buffers (plus a noop_stub tail in the binary).
signature: int fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile(uint32 target_x, uint32 target_y, uint32 char_idx, uint32 ctx)

params.name: target_x
params.semantics: Destination tile X column. Callers pass the chosen target char's bPos_x (dispatcher cases 3/9), a pickup tile X (case 5), an AI aux target X (case 7), or the nearest team target's X.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches caller-supplied target tile X; no address residue.

params.name: target_y
params.semantics: Destination tile Y row, paired with target_x from the same caller sources.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches caller-supplied target tile Y; no address residue.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index of the moving character into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (each entry RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE bytes). Used to read src pos / range / class and is forwarded to occupant-marking and walk-animation helpers.
params.reason: Standard runtime-char index name used throughout this file; accurate, no address residue.

params.name: ctx
params.semantics: Team/context flag forwarded unchanged to fd2_paint_threat_overlay_for_team(ctx) and fd2_mark_char_occupant_tiles_for_team(char_idx, ctx). Dispatcher passes its ctx_flag (param_2); fd2_ai_advance_to_nearest_team_target passes its team argument.
params.reason: Generic but correct: it is an opaque team/context flag threaded through helper calls, not used for arithmetic here; no address residue.

returns.semantics: 1 if a walk actually occurred (final pathfind produced a path of non-zero length and fd2_walk_path_animation_loop ran); 0 otherwise (no reachable path).

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was a correct one-liner (two-stage pathfind, fallback to closest tile, return 1/0) but omitted the long-range Stage-B retry, the furthest-walkable-tile scan, and the best-adjacent-tile selection (taxicab distance with diagonal tiebreak), and did not document the ctx parameter.
notes: Function signature in src matches Ghidra __cdecl(int,int,int,int). No global writes (tile-map mutations happen inside helper calls, not via direct writes in this body). Callers confirmed: fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher (cases 3/5/7/9), fd2_ai_advance_to_nearest_team_target, fd2_ai_seek_optimal_position, fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack, fd2_field_command_menu_loop. Ghidra plate is already detailed and consistent with the refined understanding, so left unchanged.
